related.title: 5G NR TDD：上下行比例與保護開銷
related.titleEn: 5G NR TDD: downlink/uplink shares and guard overhead
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 500 microsecond 與 125 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 500 microsecond and 125 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋70 Mbit/s downlink與50 Mbit/s downlink，建立tdd_pattern.csv、雙方向需求表、保護區間圖，並完成以下驗收：需求DL60/UL15時第一組可行而第二不可；另設需求DL45/UL30時第二組可行而第一不可，沒有普遍最佳配比。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 70 Mbit/s downlink and 50 Mbit/s downlink; create tdd_pattern.csv, bidirectional demand table and guard intervals; apply this acceptance decision: For DL60/UL15 the first passes and second fails; a separate DL45/UL30 demand makes only the second pass, so no ratio is universally best.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 正常CP之NR時槽時間依2^mu縮放；提高子載波間距縮短時槽，但不單獨保證端到端低延遲。 展開基準式 1000/2**1；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：每1 ms時間窗分別應放2與8個時槽；計數與時間乘積必須回到1000 microsecond。 將兩條推導一起存入 nr_slots.csv、時間格線、端到端延遲分解。
從原理 TDD共用時間資源，方向切換保護與UL/DL分配皆消耗時槽；不能把全時間PHY率同時給上下行。 展開基準式 100*7/10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把DL、UL、guard三者比例相加為1；分別計UL20與40 Mbit/s並保留方向標籤。 將兩條推導一起存入 tdd_pattern.csv、雙方向需求表、保護區間圖。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For normal-CP NR, slot duration scales with2^mu; larger subcarrier spacing shortens slots but does not alone guarantee low end-to-end latency., expand baseline expression 1000/2**1; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: A1 ms window contains2 or8 slots; slot count times duration must recover1000 microseconds. Save both derivations with nr_slots.csv, timing grid and end-to-end delay decomposition.

Starting from TDD shares time resources; switching guards and UL/DL allocation consume slots, so both directions cannot receive full-time PHY rate simultaneously., expand baseline expression 100*7/10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum DL, UL and guard fractions to1; independently compute UL20 and40 Mbit/s and retain direction labels. Save both derivations with tdd_pattern.csv, bidirectional demand table and guard intervals.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.11a OFDM：符元到資訊位元的換算
related.titleEn: IEEE802.11a OFDM: symbols to information bits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 500 microsecond 與 125 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 500 microsecond and 125 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋12 Mbit/s與24 Mbit/s，建立wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界，並完成以下驗收：18 Mbit/s PHY教學目標只第二配置滿足；若SNR不支援16QAM則必須降需求。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 12 Mbit/s and 24 Mbit/s; create wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second meets an18 Mbit/s PHY target; reduce demand if SNR cannot support16QAM.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 正常CP之NR時槽時間依2^mu縮放；提高子載波間距縮短時槽，但不單獨保證端到端低延遲。 展開基準式 1000/2**1；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：每1 ms時間窗分別應放2與8個時槽；計數與時間乘積必須回到1000 microsecond。 將兩條推導一起存入 nr_slots.csv、時間格線、端到端延遲分解。

從原理 名義資訊率由資料子載波數、調變位元、碼率與符元時間決定；前導與競爭會再降低MAC有效率。 展開基準式 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算每符元48與96資訊bit，再數一秒250000符元；確認導頻未算成資料。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For normal-CP NR, slot duration scales with2^mu; larger subcarrier spacing shortens slots but does not alone guarantee low end-to-end latency., expand baseline expression 1000/2**1; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: A1 ms window contains2 or8 slots; slot count times duration must recover1000 microseconds. Save both derivations with nr_slots.csv, timing grid and end-to-end delay decomposition.

Starting from Nominal information rate depends on data subcarriers, modulation bits, code rate and symbol duration; preambles and contention reduce MAC goodput., expand baseline expression 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compute48/96 information bits per symbol then250000 symbols per second; pilots must not count as data. Save both derivations with wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
